purpose: Prove that Prismel HeroCel production authority survives frame-to-frame motion without likeness, geometry, silhouette, or rendering-family drift before staff materialization or attack production begins.

generationContract.referenceRule: Use Prismel HeroCel Master B as the only character visual reference. Master A geometry locks remain absolute through the production authority. Do not include Kineza, presentation sheets, attack art, or unrelated Prismel variants as visual references.
generationContract.camera: identical neutral full-body camera and perspective in all six frames
generationContract.background: plain neutral production background or transparent production field
generationContract.poseIntent: calm mystical readiness with restrained natural life, never energetic Kineza-style bounce

framePlan.allowedMotion: none; canonical Master B idle anchor
minimal upper-chest and shoulder breathing only; feet, head scale, facial geometry, belt line, and crystal position remain anchored
subtle outer-cloak fold response to breathing; no silhouette inflation or hem translation
returning chest/shoulder breath with identical root and face geometry
very small luminance pulse in the chest crystal only; crystal geometry, scale, centroid, and mounting remain unchanged
visual return to frame 1 anchor suitable for a seamless loop

absoluteLocks: central chest crystal size and placement
renderingLocks: maximum one restrained facial transition band
clustered cosmic detail subordinate to silhouette
chest crystal as high-detail focal material
hardReject: chest crystal relocation, resizing, or anatomy fusion
uniform cosmic-noise changes that read as texture flicker
promotionRule: Idle stability must pass PriZim visual inspection, post-registration tolerances, and phone playback before Prismel proceeds to movement/pose stability or any staff/attack sequence adaptation.
